name: Telcoin MXN
oneLiner: eMXN is Telcoin's centralized Mexican peso stablecoin on Polygon, backed by MXN reserves managed by Telcoin and used for Digital Cash payments.
collateral: Mexican-peso Digital Cash reserve backing managed by Telcoin for eMXN issued on Polygon
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed Mexican-peso Digital Cash stablecoin used for payments and settlement in the Telcoin Wallet; public materials do not yet expose an eMXN-specific redemption or reserve-attestation report

jurisdiction.regulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance

applicabilityBasis.summary: Telcoin lists eMXN as a live Digital Cash stablecoin issued under a Nebraska-chartered Digital Asset Depository Bank, positioning it as a 1:1 MXN-backed payment instrument.

genius.issuerEntity: Telcoin, Inc. / Telcoin Digital Asset Bank
genius.stateRegulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance
genius.notes: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank holds a Nebraska Digital Asset Depository charter (final approval Nov 2025) and has publicly positioned itself as GENIUS Act-aligned through that framework. No GENIUS PPSI approval or filed application exists; the GENIUS Act is still in proposed-rules rulemaking and no state has been certified as substantially similar. The telco.in/digital-cash page states Telcoin will publish monthly attestations -- future tense as of June 2026; none have been located in public sources. No eMXN-specific reserve disclosure URL was found. The stored issuerPathway remains unknown; Telcoin frames Nebraska as its intended GENIUS-aligned route, but no achieved state-qualified approval was found.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was located for eMXN or Telcoin. The Nebraska charter is a state-law instrument and no state has been certified as substantially similar under GENIUS as of June 2026. Telcoin publicly frames its Nebraska charter as GENIUS-aligned but has not filed a formal GENIUS PPSI application; the application framework itself remains in proposed rulemaking.

reserves.name: Mexican peso fiat reserves for Telcoin Digital Cash
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Telcoin Digital Asset Bank and undisclosed Mexican reserve institutions

reserveReview.rationale: Telcoin's Digital Cash disclosure identifies eMXN as a live Mexican-peso Digital Cash asset on Polygon and describes the product family as issued through regulated financial institutions. The reviewed primary sources do not publish an eMXN-specific reserve report, asset-class split, named reserve institution, or fixed redemption window, so the existing 100% aggregate envelope is retained without fabricated subcategories.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Telcoin Digital Cash issuer disclosure for the eMXN reserve envelope
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full 100% reserve envelope lacks eMXN-specific category weights, named institutions, and an external assurance report. Telcoin states that monthly attestations will be published, but none was located in the reviewed sources.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Mexican peso fiat reserves for Telcoin Digital Cash
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer describes the Digital Cash reserve concept but does not publish eMXN-specific composition or assurance evidence.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources identify Telcoin's regulated-bank framework but do not identify the eMXN reserve account, Mexican bank counterparties, legal segregation, bankruptcy treatment, or rehypothecation terms. The custody profile is therefore intentionally unknown until an eMXN-specific report is published.
